title: Ask the Guru before you scatter
summary: This meets the anxious search for the right practice, teacher, or move. The line steadies the question by turning it toward the Guru instead of frantic self-invention.
takeaway: Take the question to the Guru first.
lifeApplication: Before opening another tab, asking another friend, or changing the plan again, stop with the question in your chest. Carry it to the Guru before carrying it everywhere else.

source.shortMeaning: The seeking heart becomes clear when it takes its question to the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: When uncertainty spreads, ask the Guru before you ask the crowd.
